$comment: Three masking recipes. Pick one. Each maps to a snippet in vex-snippets.vfl.

recipes.name: Rim mask
recipes.what_it_looks_like: Bright corona where the surface bends away from the camera-facing direction; dark elsewhere.
recipes.good_for: Edge breakup. Carapace plates. Anything where you want scatter to crowd the silhouette.

recipes.name: Dual-noise cluster mask
recipes.what_it_looks_like: Patchy clusters at two scales — large continents of high density, with smaller islands inside.
recipes.good_for: Organic clumping. Lichen, pustules, rivets, freckle-like detail.

recipes.name: Distance-from-curve gradient
recipes.what_it_looks_like: A fall-off band along a user-supplied curve (xyzdist on input 1).
recipes.good_for: Wound trails. Vein routing. Anything aligned to a sketched stroke.

honesty: All three recipes are deterministic — same parameters → same mask. Reproducibility is part of the proof.
